What is the best time to visit North East India?

The best time to visit North East India is from October to April, when the weather is pleasant, skies are clear and road conditions are ideal for sightseeing.

Different seasons offer different experiences:

October to November: Clear mountain views, festivals and comfortable weather.
December to February: Snowfall in Tawang, beautiful winter landscapes and wildlife safaris in Kaziranga.
March to April: Blooming flowers, pleasant temperatures and excellent conditions for sightseeing.
May to September: Lush green landscapes and waterfalls in Meghalaya during the monsoon.

Is North East India safe for tourists?

Yes, North East India is one of the safest regions in India for tourists, including families, couples, solo travellers and senior citizens. Popular destinations like Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, and Kaziranga National Park welcome thousands of domestic and international visitors every year.

People in North East India are known for their warm hospitality and friendly nature. Tourist destinations are generally peaceful, and local communities are welcoming towards visitors.

If you're travelling to remote regions such as Tawang, Mechuka, Anini or Ziro Valley, it's always advisable to travel with a reliable North East India tour operator who can arrange permits, experienced drivers and local assistance.
